key_points: Most headlines are not MS-specific: GTA VI/Take-Two, Robinhood, Anthropic, Everpure, and Microsoft items are unrelated to Morgan Stanley fundamentals.

MS-specific news is research/thought-leadership content: a $1T AI funding wave call, a $1.6T 2027 AI capex forecast, and new AI/energy funds launched in Europe — franchise marketing rather than earnings drivers.
Co-President Simkowitz flagged ample capital for AI buildout but warned of higher financing costs for other borrowers and power-supply constraints — a balanced, mildly two-sided signal.
No earnings, guidance, M&A, legal/regulatory, or management changes in the window; rotational-strategy and opinion pieces are noise.
Net: no change to thesis; MS remains a rate/AI-capex-cycle levered franchise story, and these items don't move near-term estimates.
